row_data.title: GNPS - Resilience of Tropical Eastern Pacific corals
row_data.description: This study investigates how two species of cauliflower corals, which differ in their susceptibility to heat stress, respond to a natural marine heatwave at the metabolomic level. By tracking tagged colonies before, during, and after the heatwave, we aim to characterize shifts in metabolomic profiles and examine how these changes correspond to underlying gene expression patterns. Our objective is to integrate molecular and metabolomic networks to identify mechanisms that shape coral resilience or vulnerability to thermal stress. Untargeted LC-MS/MS acquisition was performed on a Vanquish Flex UHPLC system coupled to an Orbitrap Exploris 240 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany). Chromatographic separation was performed on a Kinetex 2.6 um 100 A pore size Polar C18 reversed phase UHPLC column 100 x 2.1 mm (Phenomenex, Torrance, CA).
